measurement_basis: Actual GLB POSITION extents plus its retained node matrix; Blender glTF conversion maps localY to worldZ and localZ to negative worldY. The source node retains a -0.849195 degree world-Z yaw. Local positiveX is the candidate face/front direction; the actual front/face renders must confirm it before visual review.
crop_scope: Explicit source-space morphology crops, not anatomical joints, skin groups or deletion masks. Keep original geometry and node transform; no source scaling or meter assumption. Left/right refer to the character.
